name: Photos and captures
one_line: Files whose primary evidence is capture metadata: what device made this image, video or scan, when, where, and what kind of capture it is.
design_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type

fields.why: 00 names it: "Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type". The ceiling is direct because the value comes from a labelled metadata slot: "A direct fact was read from a reliable and explicit source, such as a content hash, EXIF timestamp, document title, or labeled form field", and 00 shows the observation/fact split on exactly this field: "an EXIF field called DateTimeOriginal is raw metadata; capture date = 2026-07-17 is the file fact derived from it". A year read out of a filename or a folder name is a possible clue, not a direct fact, and a bare 4-digit number is never a capture year.

00 names it in the Photos field sentence and gives the rule family that confirms it: "Camera EXIF, GPS, and capture time can support deterministic photo-event proposals" and "For a photo group, it might be a deterministic event created from camera, time, and GPS metadata". Rule family: capture-metadata event clustering over camera identity, capture time and GPS. A P9 group label reaches this field only as a value the user accepts; membership in a neighbourhood never writes the event onto a member.

00 names it in the Photos field sentence. Rule family: place-gazetteer resolution of an EXIF GPS fix (R4's content, word-boundary matched), or a place name in OCR with capture context. The coordinate itself is not the stored value and does not leave the machine: "Paths, complete extracted text, OCR output, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, user edits, group memberships, and raw sensitive values should remain local."

00 names it in the Photos field sentence, and the canonical row seeds it destination_eligible false. It is one of the "several additional fields used only for search, privacy protection, explanation, or later review". Ceiling user_confirmed: nothing in this product identifies a person from a capture without the user saying so, and 00 makes person visibility a user choice — "The user can choose whether names, previews, thumbnails, OCR text, or location data are shown."

00 names it in the Photos field sentence. Direct because EXIF make/model/lens is a labelled structured slot. It is evidence, not a folder level: 00's Photos template is year then event, and 00 warns that "A folder should not become a collection point for everything produced by the same person or organization."

00 names it in the Photos field sentence. Rule family: 00's own image-signal hierarchy — "camera EXIF is strong photo evidence; capture time, GPS, and sensor-shaped dimensions reinforce it; exact display resolutions, PNG format, and software metadata may support a screenshot hypothesis; conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification". Members are values discovered at runtime, never roster nodes. Whether this field may open a folder level in the default template is recorded in open_question.

template.why: 00's own Photos template — "a Photos template may define year → event" — and 00's stated exception to putting subject before time: "Photos and capture-based media are the major exception: time often belongs first because capture date is a defining aspect of the material." location and media_type are destination-eligible and available as optional dimensions on other templates over this schema; the schema's default template stays 00's two. The order is a recommendation the user may reverse, remove, add to, or flatten.

collides_with.signal: The confusable evidence item is the capture metadata itself: a phone photograph of a passport carries genuine camera EXIF and a capture time, which alone would propose capture facts and a photo-event home for a protected record. The discriminating evidence is document-identity wording in the OCR region, and 00 puts protection first — "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately" and "Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold".

Same shape: a photographed clinical letter or a photographed prescription carries camera EXIF and a capture time, which alone would route it into a photo event by year. The discriminating evidence is clinical wording in the OCR region; protection precedes any model or placement path, so the capture reading must never be the one that decides the file's home.

also_holds_with.signal: A microscope, gel or field image is legitimately both a capture and a research artifact, on disjoint evidence: imaging-device metadata and a capture time on one side, a project or lab identifier and experimental context on the other. This is 00's stated shape — "One file may hold facts from more than one domain without losing information" — and neither reading drops the other's fields.

sensitivity_why: Captures carry location and people by design, and 00 puts their raw forms behind the local boundary — "Paths, complete extracted text, OCR output, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, user edits, group memberships, and raw sensitive values should remain local" — and makes their display a user choice: "The user can choose whether names, previews, thumbnails, OCR text, or location data are shown." A capture is also the commonest carrier of another domain's protected content, since an image may be a photograph of an identity document, an account record or a clinical letter. Handling classes are not assigned here.
open_question: May media_type open a folder level in this schema's default template? 00 states only year then event for Photos, and the schema's other two destination-eligible fields (location, media_type) are unused by that order. Splitting photos from screenshots at the top is the split most users appear to want, but it is a decision about someone's real filesystem, and 00 gives no sentence for it. Recorded rather than resolved. A second, smaller fork: the canonical row seeds people destination_eligible false for privacy reasons; widening it is likewise Joseph's, never a schema's.
